name: Stratos Project Ruby Pipeline Lateral
monitor_reason: no concrete step for the lateral itself: the Utah development agreement only allows a gas service deal with Tallgrass, no signed gas contract, filing, or tender found; length and endpoints unknown
researcher_notes: This is not an existing row. The Ruby Gas Pipeline row (P0248) is the mainline only. The Stratos campus is a data center project in Hansel Valley, Box Elder County, Utah, with a stated plan for gas from the Ruby Pipeline, which crosses the valley. A June 2026 LandGate article says the original plan was on-site gas generation drawing on Ruby, and that the governor then said the campus would never run solely on gas. The first phase is now described as 1 to 1.5 gigawatts of gas with other sources later. Press reports say the April 2026 development agreement lets the developer arrange gas service from Tallgrass Energy through a connection to Ruby. That is permission, not a signed gas contract, a filing or a construction award. No length, route, diameter or capacity for a lateral was found, and the connection may be a short tap. A data center tie exists, so there is no length floor, but the add threshold is not met. Do not tag Ruby (P0248) as a data center line. A Baxtel listing and an Energy Mix article repeat the Ruby gas plan but were not used as refs (Baxtel gave no readable pipeline text, Energy Mix blocked access). Watch for a Tallgrass or Ruby connection filing, a Utah air permit naming a gas line, or a signed gas service agreement.
